notes_for_editor: Thin. Two sources agree on a 1910 wooden tower of about 35 ft and on the Pike County location. Neither gives coordinates, staffing, fires, fate beyond 'no longer standing', or access. A search returned a firelookout.org inventory row that mentions Flat Ridge, but that page returned 404 on fetch, so nothing from it is used. The record's coordinates are an approximate GNIS name match and are not verified for this tower.
